objectives.text: Read a percent as a count out of one hundred: 25% as 25 out of 100
successCriteria: I can say that 25% means 25 out of 100
I can show 25% by shading twenty-five cells on the hundred-grid
assessmentPoints: Hundred-grid answers in the opening activity
Responses when the trap is sprung in the second activity

objectives.text: Find a percent of a quantity by turning it into a fraction of the whole: 25% as one quarter
successCriteria: I can simplify 25% to one quarter
I can work out 25% of 60 as 60 / 4 = 15
assessmentPoints: Guided quartering answers in the third activity
Worksheet answers in the closing practice

activities.title: Hundred-grid: shade twenty-five out of one hundred

differentiation.support: Provide the hundred-grid and a bar split into four equal parts so the quarter can be seen before it is calculated.

differentiation.stretch: Ask learners to find 10% of 60 using the same per-hundred method.
